spec.title: Code Coverage
spec.description: Test coverage across the SonarQube projects mapped to the selected projects, weighted by lines to cover.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_cq AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS cq_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cq_projects' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
SELECT ROUND(100 * (1 - SUM(fm.uncovered_lines) / NULLIF(SUM(fm.lines_to_cover), 0)), 1) AS value
FROM cq_file_metrics fm
WHERE fm.project_key IN (SELECT cq_id FROM scoped_cq)

spec.title: Sonar Bugs
spec.description: Open SonarQube bugs (not closed or resolved) in the mapped projects.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_cq AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS cq_id

spec.title: By project
spec.description: Coverage is weighted by lines to cover and shows red below 50, orange below 70, green from 70. Quality gate status is not collected.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_cq AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS cq_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cq_projects' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
, files AS (
  SELECT fm.project_key,
    100 * (1 - SUM(fm.uncovered_lines) / NULLIF(SUM(fm.lines_to_cover), 0)) AS coverage,
    SUM(fm.security_hotspots) AS hotspots,
    SUM(fm.sqale_index) / 480 AS debt
  FROM cq_file_metrics fm
  WHERE fm.project_key IN (SELECT cq_id FROM scoped_cq)
  GROUP BY fm.project_key
),
open_issues AS (
  SELECT ci.project_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ci.type = 'BUG' THEN ci.id END) AS bugs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ci.type = 'VULNERABILITY' THEN ci.id END) AS vulns
  FROM cq_issues ci
  WHERE ci.project_key IN (SELECT cq_id FROM scoped_cq)
    AND ci.type IN ('BUG', 'VULNERABILITY') AND COALESCE(ci.status, '') NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'RESOLVED')
  GROUP BY ci.project_key
)
SELECT cp.name AS Project,
  ROUND(f.coverage, 1) AS "Coverage %",
  COALESCE(oi.bugs, 0) AS Bugs,
  COALESCE(oi.vulns, 0) AS Vulns,
  ROUND(f.hotspots) AS "Hotspots unreviewed",
  ROUND(f.debt, 1) AS "Debt (d)",
  cp.last_analysis_date AS "Last analysis"
FROM cq_projects cp
JOIN scoped_cq sc ON sc.cq_id = cp.id
LEFT JOIN files f ON f.project_key = cp.id
LEFT JOIN open_issues oi ON oi.project_key = cp.id
ORDER BY cp.name

spec.title: AI impact overview
spec.description: The selected range, in the selected projects. AI-assisted PRs: share of merged PRs with a Claude co-author trailer or a commit Claude Code reported. Code generated: lines Claude Code added as a share of lines added by merged PRs, capped at 100%. GitLab MRs count the lines added by their commits, merge commits excluded. Code accepted: share of edit decisions that were accepted. AI lines per merged PR: lines Claude Code added divided by merged PRs. Claude active hours: time spent actively in Claude Code sessions, not time saved.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
otel_conns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cp.connection_id
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
merged AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.additions, pr.merged_date >= $__timeFrom() AS cur
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM scoped_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= ($__timeFrom() - INTERVAL TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) SECOND) AND pr.merged_date < $__timeTo()
)
, long_lived_branches AS (
  SELECT lb.base_repo_id, lb.base_ref
  FROM pull_requests lb
  WHERE lb.id LIKE 'gitlab:%' AND lb.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM scoped_repos)
  GROUP BY lb.base_repo_id, lb.base_ref
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
)
, gitlab_lines AS (
  SELECT pr.id, SUM(c.additions) AS additions, SUM(c.deletions) AS deletions
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN pull_request_commits prc ON prc.pull_request_id = pr.id
  JOIN commits c ON c.sha = prc.commit_sha
  WHERE pr.id IN (SELECT id FROM merged) AND pr.id LIKE 'gitlab:%'
    AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commit_parents cp WHERE cp.commit_sha = c.sha) < 2
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM long_lived_branches llb WHERE llb.base_repo_id = pr.base_repo_id AND llb.base_ref = pr.head_ref)
  GROUP BY pr.id
)
, ai_prs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT prc.pull_request_id AS id
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  LEFT JOIN commits c ON c.sha = prc.commit_sha
  WHERE prc.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM merged)
    AND (LOWER(CONVERT(c.message USING utf8mb4)) LIKE '%co-authored-by: claude%anthropic.com%' OR CONVERT(c.message USING utf8mb4) LIKE '%Generated with [Claude Code]%'
      OR prc.commit_sha IN (SELECT commit_sha FROM ai_commits))
)
, share AS (
  SELECT 100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.cur AND m.id IN (SELECT id FROM ai_prs) THEN m.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.cur THEN m.id END), 0) AS cur_pct,
    100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT m.cur AND m.id IN (SELECT id FROM ai_prs) THEN m.id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT m.cur THEN m.id END), 0) AS prev_pct,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.cur THEN COALESCE(gl.additions, m.additions) END) AS merged_lines,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.cur THEN m.id END) AS merged_prs
  FROM merged m
  LEFT JOIN gitlab_lines gl ON gl.id = m.id
),
claude_lines AS (
  SELECT SUM(a.lines_added) AS added_lines
  FROM ai_activities a
  WHERE a.record_kind = 'canonical_activity'
    AND a.source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM otel_conns)
    AND a.date > DATE($__timeFrom()) AND a.date <= DATE($__timeTo())
),
active AS (
  SELECT SUM(ha.active_time_seconds) / 3600.0 AS hours
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_activity ha
  WHERE ha.connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM otel_conns)
    AND ha.hour_start >= $__timeFrom() AND ha.hour_start < $__timeTo()
),
edits AS (
  SELECT 100 * SUM(d.accepted_count) / NULLIF(SUM(d.accepted_count) + SUM(d.rejected_count), 0) AS accepted_pct
  FROM ai_tool_decisions d
  WHERE d.source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM otel_conns)
    AND d.date > DATE($__timeFrom()) AND d.date <= DATE($__timeTo())
)
SELECT ROUND(s.cur_pct, 1) AS ai_assisted,
  ROUND(LEAST(100, 100 * g.added_lines / NULLIF(s.merged_lines, 0)), 1) AS code_generated,
  ROUND(e.accepted_pct, 1) AS code_accepted,
  ROUND(g.added_lines / NULLIF(s.merged_prs, 0)) AS ai_lines_per_pr,
  ROUND(h.hours, 1) AS claude_active_hours,
  CASE WHEN s.cur_pct IS NULL OR s.prev_pct IS NULL THEN '–' ELSE CONCAT(
    CASE WHEN ROUND(s.cur_pct - s.prev_pct) > 0 THEN '+' WHEN ROUND(s.cur_pct - s.prev_pct) < 0 THEN '-' ELSE '±' END,
    ABS(ROUND(s.cur_pct - s.prev_pct)), ' pp') END AS `change`
FROM share s, claude_lines g, active h, edits e

spec.title: Tokens burned
spec.description: Input, output and cache tokens used in the selected range (last 7 days by default).

spec.rawSql:
WITH
otel_conns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cp.connection_id
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.input_tokens + u.output_tokens + u.cache_read_tokens + u.cache_creation_tokens), 0) AS value
FROM ai_model_usages u
WHERE u.source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM otel_conns)
  AND u.date > DATE($__timeFrom()) AND u.date <= DATE($__timeTo())

spec.title: Prod deploys
spec.description: Successful prod deployments in the selected range (last 7 days by default), vs the previous period of the same length.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_cicd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS scope_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
, deploys AS (
  SELECT dc.cicd_deployment_id, dc.finished_date
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
    AND dc.result = 'SUCCESS' AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%'
    AND dc.finished_date >= ($__timeFrom() - INTERVAL TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) SECOND) AND dc.finished_date < $__timeTo()
)
SELECT $__timeFrom() AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT cicd_deployment_id) AS value FROM deploys WHERE finished_date < $__timeFrom()
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeTo() AS time, COUNT(DISTINCT cicd_deployment_id) AS value FROM deploys WHERE finished_date >= $__timeFrom()
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Cost per merged PR
spec.description: Estimated Claude Code cost in the selected range (last 7 days by default) divided by pull requests merged in the same period.

  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))

spec.title: Top model by spend
spec.description: The model with the highest estimated cost in the selected range (last 7 days by default).

spec.rawSql:
WITH
otel_conns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cp.connection_id
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
SELECT CONCAT(model, ' · ', CHAR(36), FORMAT(cost, 0)) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT CASE WHEN u.model LIKE 'claude-%' THEN CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(REGEXP_REPLACE(u.model, '-[0-9]{8}|\\[1m\\]', ''), '-', 2), '-', -1), 1)), SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(REGEXP_REPLACE(u.model, '-[0-9]{8}|\\[1m\\]', ''), '-', 2), '-', -1), 2), ' ', REPLACE(SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(u.model, '-[0-9]{8}|\\[1m\\]', ''), LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(REGEXP_REPLACE(u.model, '-[0-9]{8}|\\[1m\\]', ''), '-', 2)) + 2), '-', '.')) ELSE u.model END AS model, SUM(u.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost
  FROM ai_model_usages u
  WHERE u.source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM otel_conns)
    AND u.date > DATE($__timeFrom()) AND u.date <= DATE($__timeTo())
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN u.model LIKE 'claude-%' THEN CONCAT(UPPER(LEFT(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(REGEXP_REPLACE(u.model, '-[0-9]{8}|\\[1m\\]', ''), '-', 2), '-', -1), 1)), SUBSTRING(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(REGEXP_REPLACE(u.model, '-[0-9]{8}|\\[1m\\]', ''), '-', 2), '-', -1), 2), ' ', REPLACE(SUBSTRING(REGEXP_REPLACE(u.model, '-[0-9]{8}|\\[1m\\]', ''), LENGTH(SUBSTRING_INDEX(REGEXP_REPLACE(u.model, '-[0-9]{8}|\\[1m\\]', ''), '-', 2)) + 2), '-', '.')) ELSE u.model END
  ORDER BY cost DESC
  LIMIT 1
) top_model

spec.title: Spend over time
spec.description: Estimated Claude Code cost per day for ranges up to 31 days, per week for longer ones. The first and last points cover only the part of their day or week inside the range.

spec.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
periods AS (
  SELECT CAST(IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), DATE($__timeFrom()), DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY)) AS DATETIME) AS period_start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY FROM periods WHERE period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY < $__timeTo()
),
otel_conns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cp.connection_id
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
, spend AS (
  SELECT IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), DATE(u.date), DATE_SUB(DATE(u.date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(u.date) DAY)) AS period_start, SUM(u.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost
  FROM ai_model_usages u
  WHERE u.source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM otel_conns)
    AND u.date > DATE($__timeFrom()) AND u.date <= DATE($__timeTo())
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT GREATEST(w.period_start, $__timeFrom()) AS time, COALESCE(s.cost, 0) AS "Spend"
FROM periods w
LEFT JOIN spend s ON s.period_start = w.period_start
WHERE w.period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY > DATE($__timeFrom()) + INTERVAL 1 DAY
ORDER BY w.period_start

spec.title: AI-assisted share of merged PRs
spec.description: Percent of merged PRs with at least one AI-assisted commit. Up to 31 days, each daily point is the trailing 7 days ending that day; beyond that, one point per week.

spec.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
periods AS (
  SELECT CAST(IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), DATE($__timeFrom()), DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY)) AS DATETIME) AS period_start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY FROM periods WHERE period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY < $__timeTo()
),
scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
, merged AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr.id, DATE(pr.merged_date) AS d
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM scoped_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), $__timeFrom() - INTERVAL 6 DAY, $__timeFrom()) AND pr.merged_date < $__timeTo()
),
ai_prs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT prc.pull_request_id AS id
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  LEFT JOIN commits c ON c.sha = prc.commit_sha
  WHERE prc.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM merged)
    AND (LOWER(CONVERT(c.message USING utf8mb4)) LIKE '%co-authored-by: claude%anthropic.com%' OR CONVERT(c.message USING utf8mb4) LIKE '%Generated with [Claude Code]%'
      OR prc.commit_sha IN (SELECT commit_sha FROM ai_commits))
)
SELECT GREATEST(w.period_start, $__timeFrom()) AS time,
  ROUND(100 * COUNT(DISTINCT ap.id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT m.id), 0), 1) AS "AI-assisted share"
FROM periods w
LEFT JOIN merged m ON m.d >= w.period_start - INTERVAL (7 - IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7)) DAY AND m.d < w.period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY
LEFT JOIN ai_prs ap ON ap.id = m.id
GROUP BY w.period_start
ORDER BY w.period_start

spec.title: Adoption
spec.description: Engineers with Claude Code activity as a share of merged-PR authors, and the share of edits accepted. Up to 31 days, each daily point is the trailing 7 days ending that day; beyond that, one point per week. Edit acceptance is per day or week, not trailing. Same denominator as Engineers Adopted %. GitLab authors and bots are counted but can never match Claude Code, so adoption reads low where they're common.

spec.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
periods AS (
  SELECT CAST(IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), DATE($__timeFrom()), DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY)) AS DATETIME) AS period_start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY FROM periods WHERE period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY < $__timeTo()
),
scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
otel_conns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cp.connection_id
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
gh_emails AS (
  SELECT author_email, MIN(author_id) AS gid
  FROM _tool_github_commits
  WHERE author_id > 0
  GROUP BY author_email
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) = 1
)
, authors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE(pr.merged_date) AS d,
    CASE WHEN pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' THEN CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) ELSE pr.author_id END AS author_key
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM scoped_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), $__timeFrom() - INTERVAL 6 DAY, $__timeFrom()) AND pr.merged_date < $__timeTo()
),
ai_users AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.date AS d, CONCAT('gh:', ge.gid) AS author_key
  FROM ai_activities a
  JOIN gh_emails ge ON ge.author_email = a.user_email
  WHERE a.record_kind = 'canonical_activity' AND a.user_email <> ''
    AND a.source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM otel_conns)
    AND a.date > DATE(IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), $__timeFrom() - INTERVAL 6 DAY, $__timeFrom())) AND a.date <= DATE($__timeTo())
),
edits AS (
  SELECT IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), DATE(d.date), DATE_SUB(DATE(d.date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(d.date) DAY)) AS period_start,
    100 * SUM(d.accepted_count) / NULLIF(SUM(d.accepted_count) + SUM(d.rejected_count), 0) AS accepted_pct
  FROM ai_tool_decisions d
  WHERE d.source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM otel_conns)
    AND d.date > DATE($__timeFrom()) AND d.date <= DATE($__timeTo())
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT GREATEST(w.period_start, $__timeFrom()) AS time,
  ROUND(100 * COUNT(DISTINCT u.author_key) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT a.author_key), 0), 1) AS "Adoption %",
  ROUND(MAX(e.accepted_pct), 1) AS "Edit acceptance %"
FROM periods w
LEFT JOIN authors a ON a.d >= w.period_start - INTERVAL (7 - IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7)) DAY AND a.d < w.period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY
LEFT JOIN ai_users u ON u.d >= w.period_start - INTERVAL (7 - IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7)) DAY AND u.d < w.period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY AND u.author_key = a.author_key
LEFT JOIN edits e ON e.period_start = w.period_start
GROUP BY w.period_start
ORDER BY w.period_start

spec.title: Spend by repository
spec.description: Claude Code cost per repository over the selected range (last 7 days by default); Mapping says whether the repository belongs to the selected projects. Cost is the exporter's estimate.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))

),
repo_spend AS (
  SELECT p.repository_url,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.session_id) AS sessions,
    COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(p.user_email, ''), p.user_key)) AS people,
    SUM(p.estimated_cost_usd) AS cost,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM repos r JOIN scoped_repos sr ON sr.repo_id = r.id WHERE LOWER(r.url) = p.repository_url) AS is_mapped
  FROM ai_prompts p
  WHERE p.source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM otel_conns)
    AND p.started_at >= $__timeFrom() AND p.started_at < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY p.repository_url
)

  CASE WHEN repository_url IS NULL THEN '–' WHEN is_mapped THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Mapping,
  sessions AS Sessions,
  people AS People,
  cost AS Cost,
  100 * cost / NULLIF(SUM(cost) OVER (), 0) AS Share
FROM repo_spend
ORDER BY cost DESC

spec.title: Languages Claude edited
spec.description: Edit decisions per language over the selected range (last 7 days by default): the ten most edited, then Other, with the share that were accepted in each name. It counts edit decisions rather than effort, and languages, not frameworks.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
otel_conns AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cp.connection_id
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_connection_projects cp
  WHERE cp.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
, by_language AS (
  SELECT MIN(COALESCE(NULLIF(t.language, ''), 'Unknown')) AS language,
    SUM(t.accepted_count + t.rejected_count) AS edits,
    SUM(t.accepted_count) AS accepted
  FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_tool_usage t
  WHERE t.connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM otel_conns)
    AND t.hour_start >= $__timeFrom() AND t.hour_start < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY LOWER(COALESCE(NULLIF(t.language, ''), 'Unknown'))
  HAVING SUM(t.accepted_count + t.rejected_count) > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT language, edits, accepted, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY edits DESC, language) AS rn
  FROM by_language
),
-- the ten most-edited languages, then everything else as one row
grouped AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN language ELSE 'Other' END AS language, MIN(rn) AS ord,
    SUM(edits) AS edits, SUM(accepted) AS accepted
  FROM ranked
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN rn <= 10 THEN language ELSE 'Other' END
)
SELECT CONCAT(CASE WHEN LOWER(language) = 'unknown' THEN 'Unknown' ELSE language END, ' · ', FORMAT(100 * accepted / edits, 1), '% kept') AS Language, edits AS Edits
FROM grouped
ORDER BY ord

spec.title: Net flow
spec.description: Tickets created and resolved per day for ranges up to 31 days, per week for longer ones, and the backlog open at the end of each. Epics are not counted. The first and last points cover only the part of their day or week inside the range.

spec.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
periods AS (
  SELECT CAST(IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), DATE($__timeFrom()), DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY)) AS DATETIME) AS period_start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY FROM periods WHERE period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY < $__timeTo()
),
scoped_boards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS board_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
scoped_issues AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  JOIN scoped_boards sb ON sb.board_id = bi.board_id
),
tickets AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.created_date, i.resolution_date
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM scoped_issues)
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
    AND i.created_date < NOW()
    AND (i.resolution_date IS NULL OR i.resolution_date >= LEAST(NOW() - INTERVAL 70 DAY, ($__timeFrom() - INTERVAL TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) SECOND), $__timeFrom() - INTERVAL 63 DAY))
)
SELECT GREATEST(w.period_start, $__timeFrom()) AS time,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.created_date >= GREATEST(w.period_start, $__timeFrom()) AND t.created_date < LEAST(w.period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY, $__timeTo()) THEN t.id END) AS Created,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.resolution_date >= GREATEST(w.period_start, $__timeFrom()) AND t.resolution_date < LEAST(w.period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY, $__timeTo()) THEN t.id END) AS Resolved,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.created_date < LEAST(w.period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY, $__timeTo())
    AND (t.resolution_date IS NULL OR t.resolution_date >= LEAST(w.period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY, $__timeTo())) THEN t.id END) AS Backlog
FROM periods w
CROSS JOIN tickets t
GROUP BY w.period_start
ORDER BY w.period_start

spec.title: By state
spec.description: Tickets open now or resolved in the selected range per group, split into done, in progress and to do. Jira uses its status; GitHub and GitLab issues count as in progress when a linked pull request is open, otherwise when they have an assignee. Blocked tickets count as in progress. Hover a bar for the done, in progress and to do counts. A ticket with several labels is counted under each. Milestone is Jira's first fix version or a GitHub milestone; GitLab has none. The date is the latest ticket due date.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_boards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS board_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
scoped_issues AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  JOIN scoped_boards sb ON sb.board_id = bi.board_id
),
open_pr_issues AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pri.issue_id
  FROM pull_request_issues pri
  JOIN pull_requests p2 ON p2.id = pri.pull_request_id AND p2.status = 'OPEN'
)
, tickets AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.due_date, i.fix_versions, i.epic_key, i.id LIKE 'jira:%' AS is_jira, CASE WHEN i.original_status = 'Closed' THEN 'DONE' WHEN i.original_status IN ('To Do', 'To do', 'Todo') THEN 'TODO' WHEN i.original_status = 'Ready for Development' THEN 'TODO' WHEN i.id NOT LIKE 'jira:%' AND i.status <> 'DONE' THEN CASE WHEN i_opr.issue_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_id, '') <> '' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'TODO' END ELSE i.status END AS bucket
  FROM issues i
  LEFT JOIN open_pr_issues i_opr ON i_opr.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM scoped_issues)
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
    AND (i.resolution_date IS NULL
      OR (i.resolution_date >= $__timeFrom() AND i.resolution_date < $__timeTo()
        AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid')))
),
epics AS (
  SELECT e.issue_key, MIN(e.title) AS title
  FROM issues e
  WHERE e.type = 'EPIC' AND e.issue_key <> '' AND e.id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM scoped_issues)
  GROUP BY e.issue_key
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT t.id, COALESCE(il.label_name, 'Unlabelled') AS grp, NULL AS due
  FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN issue_labels il ON il.issue_id = t.id
  WHERE '$grouping' = 'Label'
  UNION
  SELECT bi.issue_id, b.name, NULL
  FROM scoped_boards sb
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.board_id = sb.board_id
  JOIN boards b ON b.id = bi.board_id
  WHERE '$grouping' = 'Board'
  UNION
  SELECT t.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.fix_versions, ',', 1)), ''), 'No milestone'), IF(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.fix_versions, ',', 1)), '') IS NULL, NULL, t.due_date)
  FROM tickets t
  WHERE '$grouping' = 'Milestone' AND t.is_jira
  UNION
  SELECT t.id, COALESCE(s.name, 'No milestone'), NULL
  FROM tickets t
  LEFT JOIN sprint_issues si ON si.issue_id = t.id
  LEFT JOIN sprints s ON s.id = si.sprint_id
  WHERE '$grouping' = 'Milestone' AND NOT t.is_jira
  UNION
  SELECT t.id, COALESCE(e.title, 'No epic'), IF(e.title IS NULL, NULL, t.due_date)
  FROM tickets t
  LEFT JOIN epics e ON e.issue_key = t.epic_key
  WHERE '$grouping' = 'Epic'
)
SELECT CONCAT(g.grp,
    IF(MAX(g.due) IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(' · due ', DATE_FORMAT(MAX(g.due), '%e %b')), ''),
    ' · ', ROUND(100 * SUM(t.bucket = 'DONE') / COUNT(*)), '%') AS label,
  SUM(t.bucket = 'DONE') AS Done,
  SUM(t.bucket = 'IN_PROGRESS') AS "In progress",
  SUM(t.bucket NOT IN ('DONE', 'IN_PROGRESS')) AS "To do"
FROM grouped g
JOIN tickets t ON t.id = g.id
GROUP BY g.grp
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, g.grp
LIMIT 15

spec.title: Where the effort went
spec.description: Tickets closed per day for ranges up to 31 days, per week for longer ones, split into unplanned, bug and feature in that order of precedence. Epics and cancelled or invalid tickets are not counted. The first and last points cover only the part of their day or week inside the range. Unplanned means added to a sprint after it started (carry-overs excluded), created in Jira straight into a running sprint, or labelled Mid-Sprint-Task. Jira sub-tasks created in a running sprint aren't counted, since they inherit their parent's sprint.

spec.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
periods AS (
  SELECT CAST(IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), DATE($__timeFrom()), DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY)) AS DATETIME) AS period_start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY FROM periods WHERE period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY < $__timeTo()
),
scoped_boards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS board_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
scoped_issues AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  JOIN scoped_boards sb ON sb.board_id = bi.board_id
),
closed AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.resolution_date
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM scoped_issues)
    AND i.resolution_date >= LEAST(NOW() - INTERVAL 70 DAY, ($__timeFrom() - INTERVAL TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) SECOND), $__timeFrom() - INTERVAL 63 DAY) AND i.resolution_date < NOW()
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
    AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid')
),
-- positions 1..60 inside a comma-separated sprint list (prod lists hold at most 16)
list_positions AS (
  SELECT a.d + 10 * b.d + 1 AS n
  FROM (SELECT 0 AS d UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) a
  CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS d UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5) b
),
sprint_changes AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ic.issue_id, ic.created_date, ic.original_to_value, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, '') AS from_value
  FROM issue_changelogs ic
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM closed) cl ON cl.id = ic.issue_id
  WHERE ic.field_name = 'Sprint'
),
-- one row per sprint the change added the issue to
sprint_adds AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sc.issue_id, sc.created_date, SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(sc.original_to_value, ',', lp.n), ',', -1) AS sprint_id
  FROM sprint_changes sc
  JOIN list_positions lp ON lp.n <= LENGTH(sc.original_to_value) - LENGTH(REPLACE(sc.original_to_value, ',', '')) + 1
  WHERE sc.original_to_value <> ''
    AND NOT FIND_IN_SET(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(sc.original_to_value, ',', lp.n), ',', -1), sc.from_value)
),
-- changes made within an hour of a from-sprint closing are carry-overs, not new work
carry_overs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sc.issue_id, sc.created_date
  FROM sprint_changes sc
  JOIN list_positions lp ON lp.n <= LENGTH(sc.from_value) - LENGTH(REPLACE(sc.from_value, ',', '')) + 1
  JOIN sprints p ON p.id = SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(sc.from_value, ',', lp.n), ',', -1)
  WHERE sc.from_value <> '' AND p.completed_date BETWEEN sc.created_date - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND sc.created_date + INTERVAL 1 HOUR
),
unplanned AS (
  SELECT sa.issue_id AS id
  FROM sprint_adds sa
  JOIN sprints s ON s.id = sa.sprint_id
  LEFT JOIN carry_overs co ON co.issue_id = sa.issue_id AND co.created_date = sa.created_date
  WHERE sa.created_date > s.started_date AND (s.completed_date IS NULL OR sa.created_date < s.completed_date)
    AND co.issue_id IS NULL
  UNION
  -- Jira tickets created straight into a sprint that was already running
  SELECT si.issue_id
  FROM sprint_issues si
  JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM closed WHERE id LIKE 'jira:%') cl ON cl.id = si.issue_id
  JOIN issues i ON i.id = si.issue_id
  JOIN sprints s ON s.id = si.sprint_id
  WHERE i.created_date > s.started_date AND (s.completed_date IS NULL OR i.created_date < s.completed_date)
    AND NOT COALESCE(i.is_subtask, 0)
  UNION
  SELECT il.issue_id
  FROM issue_labels il
  WHERE il.label_name = 'Mid-Sprint-Task' AND il.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM closed)
),
unplanned_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT id FROM unplanned
)
, typed AS (
  SELECT IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), DATE(c.resolution_date), DATE_SUB(DATE(c.resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(c.resolution_date) DAY)) AS period_start,
    CASE WHEN u.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Unplanned' WHEN (i.type = 'BUG' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels il WHERE il.issue_id = i.id AND il.label_name IN ('bug','Production-Bug'))) THEN 'Bug' ELSE 'Feature' END AS segment
  FROM closed c
  JOIN issues i ON i.id = c.id
  LEFT JOIN unplanned_ids u ON u.id = c.id
  WHERE c.resolution_date >= $__timeFrom() AND c.resolution_date < $__timeTo()
)
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(GREATEST(w.period_start, $__timeFrom()), '%m/%d') AS Period,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.segment = 'Feature' THEN 1 END) AS Feature,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.segment = 'Bug' THEN 1 END) AS Bug,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN t.segment = 'Unplanned' THEN 1 END) AS Unplanned
FROM periods w
LEFT JOIN typed t ON t.period_start = w.period_start
GROUP BY w.period_start
ORDER BY w.period_start

spec.title: Commit → merge time
spec.description: PR cycle time: first commit to merge, not to production. Median days from first commit to merge for pull requests merged in the selected range vs the previous period of the same length; the first commit falls back to the PR opening time.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
, prs AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.merged_date,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, COALESCE(MIN(ppm.first_commit_authored_date), pr.created_date), pr.merged_date) / 1440 AS days
  FROM pull_requests pr
  LEFT JOIN project_pr_metrics ppm ON ppm.id = pr.id
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM scoped_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= ($__timeFrom() - INTERVAL TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) SECOND) AND pr.merged_date < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY pr.id, pr.merged_date, pr.created_date
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT days, merged_date >= $__timeFrom() AS is_cur,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY merged_date >= $__timeFrom() ORDER BY days) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY merged_date >= $__timeFrom()) AS n
  FROM prs
)
SELECT $__timeFrom() AS time, MAX(days) AS value FROM ranked WHERE is_cur = 0 AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n)
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeTo() AS time, MAX(days) AS value FROM ranked WHERE is_cur = 1 AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n)
ORDER BY time

spec.title: Change failure rate
spec.description: A proxy until production incidents are recorded: change failure rate = prod deploy failure rate + rollbacks. Share of finished production deploy runs in the selected range that failed or were a rollback (see Rollbacks on the Flow tab); cancelled runs are not counted. The label compares with the previous period of the same length.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT value FROM (
WITH
scoped_cicd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS scope_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
prod_runs AS (
  SELECT dc.cicd_scope_id AS scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment) AS env, dc.cicd_deployment_id AS id,
    MIN(dc.started_date) AS st, MIN(dc.finished_date) AS ts, MIN(dc.commit_sha) AS sha, MAX(dc.result = 'FAILURE') AS failed,
    CASE WHEN MIN(dc.ref_name) REGEXP '[0-9]+[.][0-9]+' THEN '#release' ELSE COALESCE(MIN(dc.ref_name), '') END AS lane
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
    AND dc.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE') AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%'
    AND LOWER(COALESCE(dc.original_result, '')) NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled', 'aborted', 'stopped') AND LOWER(COALESCE(dc.original_status, '')) NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled', 'aborted', 'stopped')
    AND dc.finished_date < NOW()
  GROUP BY dc.cicd_scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment), dc.cicd_deployment_id
),
shipped AS (
  SELECT id, scope_id, env, lane, st, sha, MIN(st) OVER (PARTITION BY scope_id, env, lane, sha) AS first_st
  FROM prod_runs
  WHERE failed = 0
),
lane_seq AS (
  SELECT id, sha, first_st, LAG(sha) OVER w AS prev_sha, LAG(first_st) OVER w AS prev_first_st
  FROM shipped
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY scope_id, env, lane ORDER BY st, id)
),
rollbacks AS (
  SELECT id FROM lane_seq WHERE prev_sha IS NOT NULL AND sha <> prev_sha AND first_st < prev_first_st
),
rates AS (
  SELECT
    100 * SUM(ts >= $__timeFrom() AND (failed = 1 OR id IN (SELECT id FROM rollbacks))) / NULLIF(SUM(ts >= $__timeFrom()), 0) AS cur,
    100 * SUM(ts < $__timeFrom() AND (failed = 1 OR id IN (SELECT id FROM rollbacks))) / NULLIF(SUM(ts < $__timeFrom()), 0) AS prev
  FROM prod_runs
  WHERE ts >= ($__timeFrom() - INTERVAL TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) SECOND) AND ts < $__timeTo()
)
SELECT ROUND(cur, 1) AS value, CASE WHEN cur IS NULL OR prev IS NULL THEN '– vs previous period' ELSE CONCAT(CASE WHEN ROUND(cur - prev, 1) > 0 THEN '+' WHEN ROUND(cur - prev, 1) < 0 THEN '-' ELSE '±' END, FORMAT(ABS(ROUND(cur - prev, 1)), 1), ' pts vs previous period') END AS label FROM rates

spec.title: Merged pull requests
spec.description: Pull requests merged in the selected range (last 7 days by default), newest first. Deployed is Yes when the PR is linked to a production deployment, No when its repository deployed to production in the last 90 days but not this PR, and Unknown otherwise. AI means an AI-assisted commit.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
project_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
project_boards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS board_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
, merged AS (
  SELECT pr.id
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM project_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.merged_date < $__timeTo()
),
ai_prs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT prc.pull_request_id AS id
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  LEFT JOIN commits c ON c.sha = prc.commit_sha
  WHERE prc.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM merged)
    AND (LOWER(CONVERT(c.message USING utf8mb4)) LIKE '%co-authored-by: claude%anthropic.com%' OR CONVERT(c.message USING utf8mb4) LIKE '%Generated with [Claude Code]%'
      OR prc.commit_sha IN (SELECT commit_sha FROM ai_commits))
)
, pr_deployed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ppm.id FROM project_pr_metrics ppm
  WHERE ppm.id IN (SELECT id FROM merged) AND COALESCE(ppm.deployment_commit_id, '') <> ''
),
prod_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dc.repo_id FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM project_repos) AND dc.result = 'SUCCESS'
    AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%' AND dc.finished_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
)
SELECT CONCAT('#', pr.pull_request_key) AS "PR", pr.title AS "Title", r.name AS "Repo",
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p3.project_name ORDER BY p3.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM project_repos p3 WHERE p3.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id) AS "Team",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name, ''), NULLIF(a.user_name, ''), pr.author_name) AS "Author",
  COALESCE(tk.issue_keys, '–') AS "Ticket",
  DATE_FORMAT(pr.merged_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS "Merged",
  CASE WHEN pd.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' WHEN prr.repo_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'No' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Deployed",
  CASE WHEN pr.id IN (SELECT id FROM ai_prs) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "AI",
  pr.url AS url,
  tk.first_url AS ticket_url
FROM merged m
JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = m.id
JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.base_repo_id
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
LEFT JOIN pr_deployed pd ON pd.id = pr.id
LEFT JOIN prod_repos prr ON prr.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT pri.pull_request_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.issue_key ORDER BY i.issue_key SEPARATOR ', ') AS issue_keys,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(i.url ORDER BY i.issue_key SEPARATOR ' '), ' ', 1) AS first_url
  FROM pull_request_issues pri
  JOIN issues i ON i.id = pri.issue_id
  WHERE pri.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM merged)
    AND i.id IN (SELECT bi.issue_id FROM board_issues bi JOIN project_boards pb ON pb.board_id = bi.board_id)
  GROUP BY pri.pull_request_id
) tk ON tk.pull_request_id = pr.id
ORDER BY pr.merged_date DESC

spec.title: Contribution mix
spec.description: Counts for the selected range (last 7 days by default), one row per person and project, not a verdict: there is no combined score. PRs reviewed counts other people's PRs, once each however many reviews were left. On GitLab it counts approvals; GitLab review comments are counted under Comments. Bots are left out, and accounts with no mapped name show as "Unmapped account". Verified is Jira only. People are matched by display name, so one person using different names in different tools appears as separate rows.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
project_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))

  FROM project_mapping pm

)
, win_prs AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.author_id, pr.author_name, pr.base_repo_id, pr.created_date
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.created_date >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.created_date < $__timeTo()
),
win_comments AS (
  SELECT cm.id, cm.type, cm.account_id, cm.pull_request_id, cm.created_date
  FROM pull_request_comments cm
  WHERE cm.created_date >= $__timeFrom() AND cm.created_date < $__timeTo() AND cm.type IN ('REVIEW', 'DIFF', 'NORMAL')
),
win_commits AS (
  SELECT c.sha, c.author_name, c.authored_date
  FROM commits c
  WHERE c.authored_date >= $__timeFrom() AND c.authored_date < $__timeTo()
),
win_changelogs AS (
  SELECT ic.id, ic.issue_id, ic.author_name, ic.created_date, ic.original_from_value, ic.original_to_value, ic.field_name
  FROM issue_changelogs ic
  WHERE ic.field_name = 'status' AND ic.created_date >= $__timeFrom() AND ic.created_date < $__timeTo() AND ic.author_name <> ''
),
events AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name, ''), NULLIF(a.user_name, ''), pr.author_name) AS person, pp.project_name, 'pr' AS kind, pr.id AS ref, DATE(pr.created_date) AS day, a.user_name AS login
  FROM win_prs pr
  JOIN project_repos pp ON pp.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(ca.full_name, ''), NULLIF(ca.user_name, ''), 'Unmapped account'), pp.project_name,
    CASE WHEN cm.type <> 'REVIEW' THEN 'comment' WHEN cm.account_id <> pr.author_id THEN 'review' ELSE 'own_review' END,
    CASE WHEN cm.type = 'REVIEW' AND cm.account_id <> pr.author_id THEN cm.pull_request_id ELSE cm.id END, DATE(cm.created_date), ca.user_name
  FROM win_comments cm
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cm.pull_request_id
  JOIN project_repos pp ON pp.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id
  -- converted to accounts.id's collation so the primary key is used
  LEFT JOIN accounts ca ON ca.id = CONVERT(cm.account_id USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci
  UNION ALL
  SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN c.author_name, pp.project_name, 'commit', c.sha, DATE(c.authored_date), NULL
  FROM win_commits c
  JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.commit_sha = c.sha
  JOIN project_repos pp ON pp.repo_id = rc.repo_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN i.assignee_name, pb.project_name, 'ticket', i.id, NULL, NULL
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN project_boards pb ON pb.board_id = bi.board_id
  WHERE i.resolution_date >= $__timeFrom() AND i.resolution_date < $__timeTo()
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC' AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid') AND i.assignee_name <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN i.creator_name, pb.project_name, 'bug', i.id, NULL, NULL
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  JOIN project_boards pb ON pb.board_id = bi.board_id
  WHERE i.created_date >= $__timeFrom() AND i.created_date < $__timeTo() AND (i.type = 'BUG' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels il WHERE il.issue_id = i.id AND il.label_name IN ('bug','Production-Bug'))) AND i.creator_name <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN ic.author_name, pb.project_name, CASE WHEN (ic.field_name = 'status' AND ((ic.original_from_value IN ('In QA','QA','QA Review','Internal QA','Testing','Davd''s QA Staging','In Staging','Ready for QA') AND ic.original_to_value IN ('Verified on Staging','ACCEPTANCE','Ready for Deployment','READY FOR RELEASE TO PRODUCTIO','READY FOR RELEASE TO PRODUCTION','Ready to Release','Done','Done - In Prod')) OR ic.original_to_value = 'Verified on Staging')) THEN 'verified' ELSE 'status' END, ic.id, DATE(ic.created_date), NULL
  FROM win_changelogs ic
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = ic.issue_id
  JOIN project_boards pb ON pb.board_id = bi.board_id
)
SELECT person AS "Person", project_name AS "Team",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'pr' THEN ref END) AS "PRs",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'review' THEN ref END) AS "PRs reviewed",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'comment' THEN ref END) AS "Comments",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'ticket' THEN ref END) AS "Tickets",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'bug' THEN ref END) AS "Bugs filed",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'verified' THEN ref END) AS "Verified",
  COUNT(DISTINCT day) AS "Active days"
FROM events
WHERE person IS NOT NULL AND person <> '' AND NOT (person LIKE '%[bot]' OR person LIKE '%-bot' OR person LIKE '% bot' OR person LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%') AND NOT (COALESCE(login, '') LIKE '%[bot]' OR COALESCE(login, '') LIKE '%-bot' OR COALESCE(login, '') LIKE '% bot' OR COALESCE(login, '') LIKE 'project\_%\_bot\_%')
GROUP BY person, project_name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind IN ('pr', 'review') THEN ref END) DESC, person

spec.title: Delivery over time
spec.description: Pull requests merged and tickets closed on the left axis; successful production deployments (dashed) and staging deployments (dotted) on the right, where their smaller range would flatten against the others. Staging means a non-production environment named like staging, dev, QA, UAT, test or demo. Per day for ranges up to 31 days, per week for longer ones; the first and last points cover only the part of their day or week inside the range.

spec.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
periods AS (
  SELECT CAST(IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), DATE($__timeFrom()), DATE_SUB(DATE($__timeFrom()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY($__timeFrom()) DAY)) AS DATETIME) AS period_start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY FROM periods WHERE period_start + INTERVAL IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), 1, 7) DAY < $__timeTo()
),
scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
scoped_boards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS board_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
scoped_issues AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  JOIN scoped_boards sb ON sb.board_id = bi.board_id
),
scoped_cicd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS scope_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
closed AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.resolution_date
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM scoped_issues)
    AND i.resolution_date >= LEAST(NOW() - INTERVAL 70 DAY, ($__timeFrom() - INTERVAL TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) SECOND), $__timeFrom() - INTERVAL 63 DAY) AND i.resolution_date < NOW()
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
    AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid')
)
, merged AS (
  SELECT IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), DATE(pr.merged_date), DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY)) AS period_start, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS n
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM scoped_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= $__timeFrom() AND pr.merged_date < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY 1
),
tickets AS (
  SELECT IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), DATE(resolution_date), DATE_SUB(DATE(resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(resolution_date) DAY)) AS period_start, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS n
  FROM closed
  WHERE resolution_date >= $__timeFrom() AND resolution_date < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY 1
),
deploys AS (
  SELECT IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), DATE(dc.finished_date), DATE_SUB(DATE(dc.finished_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(dc.finished_date) DAY)) AS period_start, COUNT(DISTINCT dc.cicd_deployment_id) AS n
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
    AND dc.result = 'SUCCESS' AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%'
    AND dc.finished_date >= $__timeFrom() AND dc.finished_date < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY 1
),
staging AS (
  SELECT IF((TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 31), DATE(dc.finished_date), DATE_SUB(DATE(dc.finished_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(dc.finished_date) DAY)) AS period_start, COUNT(DISTINCT dc.cicd_deployment_id) AS n
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
    AND dc.result = 'SUCCESS' AND LOWER(dc.environment) NOT LIKE '%prod%' AND LOWER(dc.environment) REGEXP 'stag|dev|qa|uat|test|demo'
    AND dc.finished_date >= $__timeFrom() AND dc.finished_date < $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT GREATEST(w.period_start, $__timeFrom()) AS time, COALESCE(m.n, 0) AS "PRs merged", COALESCE(t.n, 0) AS "Tickets closed", COALESCE(d.n, 0) AS "Prod deploys", COALESCE(s.n, 0) AS "Staging deploys"
FROM periods w
LEFT JOIN merged m ON m.period_start = w.period_start
LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.period_start = w.period_start
LEFT JOIN deploys d ON d.period_start = w.period_start
LEFT JOIN staging s ON s.period_start = w.period_start
ORDER BY w.period_start

spec.title: By team
spec.description: One row per selected project, treated as a team. Counts cover the selected range (last 7 days by default); cycle time (tickets closed) and change failure (failed or rolled-back production deploys, as on the Quality tab) too; Open bugs counts every open bug however old. Team size is not a headcount: it counts distinct people with a merged PR, a review or a closed ticket in the selected range (last 7 days by default), and someone who works across two teams is counted in both. Bots are left out. People are matched by name, so one person with different names in different tools is counted more than once. In the queue and Oldest come from Needs attention; Claude use is the share of merged-PR authors with Claude Code activity. Same denominator as Engineers Adopted %. GitLab authors and bots are counted but can never match Claude Code, so adoption reads low where they're common.

  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
    AND dc.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE') AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%'
    AND LOWER(COALESCE(dc.original_result, '')) NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled', 'aborted', 'stopped') AND LOWER(COALESCE(dc.original_status, '')) NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled', 'aborted', 'stopped')
    AND dc.finished_date < NOW()
  GROUP BY dc.cicd_scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment), dc.cicd_deployment_id
),
issue_base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pb.project_name, pb.board_id, i.id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.url, i.priority, i.type, i.status, i.original_status,
    i.assignee_id, i.assignee_name, i.created_date, i.id LIKE 'jira:%' AS is_jira,
    COALESCE(i.updated_date, i.created_date) AS last_activity, i.updated_date
  FROM project_boards pb
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.board_id = pb.board_id
  JOIN issues i ON i.id = bi.issue_id
  WHERE i.status <> 'DONE' AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
    AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Closed', 'Cancelled', 'Invalid')
    AND COALESCE(i.updated_date, i.created_date) >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
),
status_now AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MAX(h.start_date) AS since
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.is_current_status = 1 AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM issue_base)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
first_progress AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MIN(h.start_date) AS started
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM issue_base)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
open_issues AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ib.project_name, ib.board_id, ib.id, ib.issue_key, ib.title, ib.url, ib.priority, ib.type, ib.status, ib.original_status,
    ib.assignee_id, ib.assignee_name, ib.created_date, ib.is_jira, ib.last_activity,
    COALESCE(sn.since, ib.updated_date, ib.created_date) AS status_since
  FROM issue_base ib
  LEFT JOIN status_now sn ON sn.issue_id = ib.id
)
, merged_90 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr.id, pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date) AS merge_min
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM project_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND pr.merged_date < NOW()
),
repo_med AS (
  SELECT repo_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'merge' AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN v END) AS merge_median,
    MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'pickup' AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN v END) AS pickup_median
  FROM (
    SELECT repo_id, kind, v,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id, kind ORDER BY v) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id, kind) AS n
    FROM (
      SELECT repo_id, 'merge' AS kind, merge_min AS v FROM merged_90
      UNION ALL
      SELECT m.repo_id, 'pickup', MIN(ppm.pr_pickup_time)
      FROM merged_90 m
      JOIN project_pr_metrics ppm ON ppm.id = m.id
      WHERE ppm.pr_pickup_time IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY m.id, m.repo_id
    ) vals
  ) ranked
  GROUP BY repo_id
),
open_prs_all AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr.id, pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, pp.project_name, CONCAT('#', pr.pull_request_key) AS item, pr.title, pr.url,
    pr.created_date, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, NOW()) AS age_min,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name, ''), NULLIF(a.user_name, ''), pr.author_name) AS owner
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_repos pp ON pp.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
  WHERE pr.status = 'OPEN' AND COALESCE(pr.is_draft, 0) = 0 AND pr.created_date < NOW()
),
pr_comment_last AS (
  SELECT c.pull_request_id, MAX(c.created_date) AS last_at
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  WHERE c.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM open_prs_all)
  GROUP BY c.pull_request_id
),
pr_commit_last AS (
  SELECT prc.pull_request_id, MAX(prc.commit_authored_date) AS last_at
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  WHERE prc.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM open_prs_all)
  GROUP BY prc.pull_request_id
),
open_prs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT x.id, x.repo_id, x.project_name, x.item, x.title, x.url, x.created_date, x.age_min, x.owner, x.last_activity
  FROM (
    SELECT op.id, op.repo_id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.created_date, op.age_min, op.owner,
      GREATEST(op.created_date, COALESCE(cl.last_at, op.created_date), COALESCE(kl.last_at, op.created_date)) AS last_activity
    FROM open_prs_all op
    LEFT JOIN pr_comment_last cl ON cl.pull_request_id = op.id
    LEFT JOIN pr_commit_last kl ON kl.pull_request_id = op.id
  ) x
  WHERE x.age_min >= 0 AND x.last_activity >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
),
stale_prs AS (
  SELECT op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.owner, op.age_min, op.last_activity
  FROM open_prs op
  LEFT JOIN repo_med rm ON rm.repo_id = op.repo_id
  WHERE op.age_min > COALESCE(2 * rm.merge_median, 14 * 1440)
),
waiting_reviews AS (
  SELECT op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.age_min, op.last_activity,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(prr.name, ''), prr.user_name) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(prr.name, ''), prr.user_name) SEPARATOR ', ') AS reviewers
  FROM open_prs op
  JOIN pull_request_reviewers prr ON prr.pull_request_id = op.id
  WHERE op.age_min > 2 * 1440
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments c
      WHERE c.pull_request_id = op.id AND c.account_id = prr.reviewer_id AND c.type IN ('REVIEW', 'DIFF'))
  GROUP BY op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.age_min, op.last_activity
),
resolved_90 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT i.id, bi.board_id, i.resolution_date
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (SELECT board_id FROM project_boards)
    AND i.resolution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND i.resolution_date < NOW()
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC' AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid')
),
resolved_start AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MIN(h.start_date) AS started
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM resolved_90)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
board_med AS (
  SELECT board_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN days END) AS median_days
  FROM (
    SELECT r.board_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rs.started, r.resolution_date) / 1440 AS days,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.board_id ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rs.started, r.resolution_date)) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.board_id) AS n
    FROM resolved_90 r
    JOIN resolved_start rs ON rs.issue_id = r.id
  ) ranked
  GROUP BY board_id
),
stalled AS (
  SELECT oi.project_name, oi.id, oi.issue_key, oi.title, oi.url, oi.assignee_name, oi.last_activity,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, COALESCE(fp.started, oi.status_since), NOW()) / 24 AS days_in_progress,
    COALESCE(2 * bm.median_days, 14) AS threshold_days
  FROM open_issues oi
  LEFT JOIN first_progress fp ON fp.issue_id = oi.id
  LEFT JOIN board_med bm ON bm.board_id = oi.board_id
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND oi.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
    AND COALESCE(oi.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Closed', 'To Do', 'To do', 'Todo', 'Ready for Development')
    AND NOT oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
),
multi_sprint AS (
  SELECT si.issue_id, COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) AS sprints, MIN(s.started_date) AS first_start
  FROM sprint_issues si
  JOIN sprints s ON s.id = si.sprint_id
  GROUP BY si.issue_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) >= 2
),
scope_added AS (
  SELECT ic.issue_id, MAX(ic.created_date) AS added_at
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM open_issues WHERE is_jira) oj
  JOIN issue_changelogs ic ON ic.issue_id = oj.id AND ic.field_name = 'Sprint'
  JOIN sprints s ON s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND FIND_IN_SET(s.id, ic.original_to_value) AND NOT FIND_IN_SET(s.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
  WHERE ic.created_date > s.started_date AND (s.completed_date IS NULL OR ic.created_date < s.completed_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM sprints p
      WHERE FIND_IN_SET(p.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
        AND p.completed_date BETWEEN ic.created_date - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND ic.created_date + INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
  GROUP BY ic.issue_id
),
latest_deploy AS (
  SELECT scope_id, env, sha, url, ts, failed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scope_id, env ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn
  FROM prod_deploys
),
att_raw AS (
  SELECT 'High' AS severity, 2 AS severity_rank, 'Unapproved PR' AS category, 2 AS cat_rank, op.item, op.title,
    CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440), 'd, no approving review') AS reason, FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440) AS age_days,
    op.project_name, op.owner, op.url, CONCAT('pr:', op.id) AS ref, op.last_activity
  FROM open_prs op
  LEFT JOIN repo_med rm ON rm.repo_id = op.repo_id
  WHERE op.age_min > COALESCE(rm.pickup_median, 2 * 1440)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments c WHERE c.pull_request_id = op.id AND c.status = 'APPROVED')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 'Low' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 4 ELSE 2 END,
    'Stale PR', 3, sp.item, sp.title,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      THEN CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, no activity for ', TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sp.last_activity, NOW()), 'd')
      ELSE CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, past twice the repo median to merge') END,
    FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), sp.project_name, sp.owner, sp.url, CONCAT('pr:', sp.id), sp.last_activity
  FROM stale_prs sp
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Medium' END, CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
    'Review waiting', 1, wr.item, wr.title, CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), 'd, requested reviewer has not reviewed'),
    FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), wr.project_name, wr.reviewers, wr.url, CONCAT('pr:', wr.id), wr.last_activity
  FROM waiting_reviews wr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
    'Blocked ticket', 4, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'High', 2, 'Stalled ticket', 5, st.issue_key, st.title,
    CONCAT('In progress ', FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), 'd, limit ', FLOOR(st.threshold_days), 'd'),
    FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), st.project_name, NULLIF(st.assignee_name, ''), st.url, CONCAT('issue:', st.id), st.last_activity
  FROM stalled st
  WHERE st.days_in_progress > st.threshold_days
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Not closing', 6, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('In ', ms.sprints, ' sprints without closing'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ms.first_start, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN multi_sprint ms ON ms.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 'Critical' WHEN 'High' THEN 'High' WHEN 'Medium' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END,
    CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 1 WHEN 'High' THEN 2 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
    'Open bug', 7, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(oi.priority, ''), 'Unprioritised'), ' bug open ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE (oi.type = 'BUG' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels il WHERE il.issue_id = oi.id AND il.label_name IN ('bug','Production-Bug')))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Unassigned in Ready', 8, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd, no assignee'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULL, oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND (oi.original_status IN ('Selected for Development', 'Dev Ready', 'Ready for Dev', 'Ready for Development') OR (oi.original_status IN ('To do', 'To Do', 'Todo') AND oi.id IN (SELECT si_r.issue_id FROM sprint_issues si_r JOIN sprints sp_r ON sp_r.id = si_r.sprint_id WHERE sp_r.status = 'ACTIVE'))) AND COALESCE(oi.assignee_id, '') = ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Critical', 1, 'Failed deploy', 9, CONCAT(ld.env, ' · ', LEFT(ld.sha, 7)), CONCAT(cs.name, ' · ', ld.env),
    CONCAT('Latest prod deployment failed ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), 'd ago, no success since'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), pc.project_name, NULL, ld.url, CONCAT('deploy:', ld.scope_id, ':', ld.env), ld.ts
  FROM latest_deploy ld
  JOIN project_cicd pc ON pc.scope_id = ld.scope_id
  JOIN cicd_scopes cs ON cs.id = ld.scope_id
  WHERE ld.rn = 1 AND ld.failed = 1 AND ld.ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Scope added', 10, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('Added to the active sprint ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), 'd ago'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN scope_added sa ON sa.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
),
attention AS (
  SELECT severity, severity_rank, category, item, ref, title, reason, age_days, project_name, owner, url, last_activity
  FROM (
    SELECT ar.severity, ar.severity_rank, ar.category, ar.item, ar.ref, ar.title, ar.reason, ar.age_days, ar.project_name, ar.owner, ar.url, ar.last_activity,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.project_name, ar.ref ORDER BY ar.severity_rank, ar.cat_rank) AS pick
    FROM att_raw ar
  ) ranked_items
  WHERE pick = 1
)
SELECT project_name AS Team, COUNT(*) AS "In the queue", MAX(age_days) AS "Oldest (d)"
FROM attention
GROUP BY project_name

WITH
project_boards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS board_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
project_cicd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS scope_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
scoped_cicd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS scope_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
prod_runs AS (
  SELECT dc.cicd_scope_id AS scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment) AS env, dc.cicd_deployment_id AS id,
    MIN(dc.started_date) AS st, MIN(dc.finished_date) AS ts, MIN(dc.commit_sha) AS sha, MAX(dc.result = 'FAILURE') AS failed,
    CASE WHEN MIN(dc.ref_name) REGEXP '[0-9]+[.][0-9]+' THEN '#release' ELSE COALESCE(MIN(dc.ref_name), '') END AS lane
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
    AND dc.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE') AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%'
    AND LOWER(COALESCE(dc.original_result, '')) NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled', 'aborted', 'stopped') AND LOWER(COALESCE(dc.original_status, '')) NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled', 'aborted', 'stopped')
    AND dc.finished_date < NOW()
  GROUP BY dc.cicd_scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment), dc.cicd_deployment_id
),
scoped_boards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS board_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
scoped_issues AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  JOIN scoped_boards sb ON sb.board_id = bi.board_id
),
closed AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.resolution_date
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM scoped_issues)
    AND i.resolution_date >= LEAST(NOW() - INTERVAL 70 DAY, ($__timeFrom() - INTERVAL TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) SECOND), $__timeFrom() - INTERVAL 63 DAY) AND i.resolution_date < NOW()
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
    AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid')
),
started AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id AS id, MIN(h.start_date) AS started_date
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM closed)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
teams AS (
  SELECT p.name AS project_name
  FROM projects p
  WHERE p.name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
team_issues AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pb.project_name, bi.issue_id
  FROM project_boards pb
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.board_id = pb.board_id
),
closed_team AS (
  SELECT ti.project_name, c.id, c.resolution_date
  FROM closed c
  JOIN team_issues ti ON ti.issue_id = c.id
)
, cycle_ranked AS (
  SELECT ct.project_name, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, st.started_date, ct.resolution_date) / 1440 AS days,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ct.project_name ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, st.started_date, ct.resolution_date)) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ct.project_name) AS n
  FROM closed_team ct
  JOIN started st ON st.id = ct.id
  WHERE ct.resolution_date >= $__timeFrom() AND ct.resolution_date < $__timeTo()
),
cycle_p85 AS (
  SELECT project_name, MAX(days) AS p85
  FROM cycle_ranked
  WHERE rn = CEIL(0.85 * n)
  GROUP BY project_name
),
shipped AS (
  SELECT id, scope_id, env, lane, st, sha, MIN(st) OVER (PARTITION BY scope_id, env, lane, sha) AS first_st
  FROM prod_runs
  WHERE failed = 0
),
lane_seq AS (
  SELECT id, sha, first_st, LAG(sha) OVER w AS prev_sha, LAG(first_st) OVER w AS prev_first_st
  FROM shipped
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY scope_id, env, lane ORDER BY st, id)
),
rollbacks AS (
  SELECT id FROM lane_seq WHERE prev_sha IS NOT NULL AND sha <> prev_sha AND first_st < prev_first_st
),
team_deploys AS (
  SELECT pc.project_name, r.id, (r.failed = 1 OR r.id IN (SELECT id FROM rollbacks)) AS failed
  FROM prod_runs r
  JOIN project_cicd pc ON pc.scope_id = r.scope_id
  WHERE r.ts >= $__timeFrom() AND r.ts < $__timeTo()
),
change_failure AS (
  SELECT project_name, 100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN failed THEN id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT id), 0) AS pct
  FROM team_deploys
  GROUP BY project_name
),
bug_counts AS (
  SELECT pb.project_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.id) AS bugs
  FROM project_boards pb
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.board_id = pb.board_id
  JOIN issues i ON i.id = bi.issue_id
  WHERE i.resolution_date IS NULL AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') <> 'Closed'
    AND (i.status <> 'DONE' OR i.original_status IN ('To Do', 'To do', 'Todo', 'Ready for Development')) AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
    AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid') AND (i.type = 'BUG' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels il WHERE il.issue_id = i.id AND il.label_name IN ('bug','Production-Bug')))
  GROUP BY pb.project_name
)
SELECT t.project_name AS Team,
  ROUND(cp.p85, 1) AS "Cycle p85 (d)",
  ROUND(cf.pct, 1) AS "Change failure",
  COALESCE(bc.bugs, 0) AS "Open bugs"
FROM teams t
LEFT JOIN cycle_p85 cp ON cp.project_name = t.project_name
LEFT JOIN change_failure cf ON cf.project_name = t.project_name
LEFT JOIN bug_counts bc ON bc.project_name = t.project_name
ORDER BY t.project_name

WITH
project_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
gh_emails AS (
  SELECT author_email, MIN(author_id) AS gid
  FROM _tool_github_commits
  WHERE author_id > 0
  GROUP BY author_email
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT author_id) = 1
),
teams AS (
  SELECT p.name AS project_name
  FROM projects p
  WHERE p.name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))

spec.title: Failed deploy recovery
spec.description: Median hours from a failed production deploy to the next success on the same repository (CI scope) and environment, for failures in the selected range vs the previous period of the same length. This is recovery from failed deploys, not incident restore time. Deploys still failing aren't in the median; they're listed as Critical in Needs attention.

WITH
scoped_cicd AS (

  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))

  SELECT dc.cicd_scope_id AS scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment) AS env, dc.cicd_deployment_id AS id,

  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
    AND dc.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE') AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%'

)

SELECT CONCAT(done, '/', total) AS value,
  CONCAT(COALESCE(CONCAT(ROUND(100 * done / NULLIF(total, 0)), '%'), '–'), ' done, was ',
    COALESCE(CONCAT(ROUND(100 * prev_done / NULLIF(prev_total, 0)), '%'), '–')) AS label
FROM counts

spec.title: Last prod deploy
spec.description: The newest successful production deployment: environment, finish time and commit.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_cicd AS (

  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)

FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
